title: Preconstruction Manager - Mission Critical
description: Take your next step with Saulsbury Industries! Location: Odessa, TX or Houston, TX Type: Full time General Information/Job Summary Provides leadership and management for preconstruction activities on mission critical construction projects, including data centers and other high-reliability facilities. Leads early planning, estimating, budgeting, constructability, procurement strategy, design coordination, value analysis, risk mitigation, schedule development, and project handoff to ensure projects are positioned for safe, predictable, and cost-effective execution. Works closely with clients, design partners, operations teams, estimators, trade partners, suppliers, and internal leadership to develop clear scopes, reliable budgets, realistic schedules, and executable project plans. Responsibilities/Competencies Lead preconstruction efforts for mission critical projects from pursuit, concept, and design development through GMP, buyout, and transition to construction. Develop and manage preconstruction plans, schedules, estimate milestones, procurement strategies, deliverable requirements, decision logs, and project risk registers. Coordinate with clients, architects, engineers, consultants, general contractors, trade partners, vendors, utilities, authorities having jurisdiction, and internal project teams. Lead constructability reviews, design coordination, scope gap analysis, value engineering, logistics planning, phasing analysis, and construction readiness reviews. Oversee preparation of conceptual, schematic, design development, and GMP estimates; validate assumptions, quantities, escalation, contingencies, allowances, exclusions, and alternates. Manage bid package development, subcontractor and supplier prequalification, RFP preparation, bid solicitation, bid leveling, scope reviews, interviews, and award recommendations. Support procurement planning for long-lead mission critical equipment, including electrical gear, generators, UPS systems, mechanical equipment, controls, fire protection, and prefabricated assemblies. Develop and maintain preconstruction budgets, cost models, cash flow projections, cost trend logs, scope reconciliation documents, and pricing updates throughout design progression. Partner with scheduling and operations teams to develop baseline preconstruction and construction schedules, including permitting, utility coordination, procurement, commissioning, energization, and turnover milestones. Provide technical input related to mission critical systems, redundancy requirements, MEP coordination, commissioning readiness, site logistics, and phased delivery strategies. Prepare and present preconstruction updates, cost reports, risk summaries, procurement status, schedule impacts, and decision recommendations to clients and company leadership. Support business development and pursuit efforts, including proposal content, interview preparation, client presentations, market intelligence, and relationship development. Complete other responsibilities associated with the position as may be appropriate. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field preferred; equivalent preconstruction, estimating, or construction management experience may be considered. 8+ years of progressive construction experience, including significant experience in preconstruction, estimating, procurement, project management, or related construction leadership roles. Demonstrated experience supporting mission critical, data center, industrial, advanced manufacturing, healthcare, or similarly complex technical construction projects; direct data center experience is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of conceptual estimating, detailed estimating, GMP development, bid leveling, scope reconciliation, constructability review, value analysis, and preconstruction deliverables. Working knowledge of delivery models such as design-build, CM-at-Risk, EPC, general contracting, owner’s representative, and/or program management. Familiarity with mission critical MEP systems, long-lead equipment procurement, utility coordination, redundancy concepts, commissioning, integrated systems testing, and operational turnover requirements. Ability to read and interpret drawings, specifications, contracts, estimates, schedules, bid packages, and technical documentation. Proficiency with estimating, scheduling, project controls, document management, and construction collaboration tools; experience with platforms such as Bluebeam, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Primavera P6, MS Project, or similar is preferred. Strong leadership, communication, analytical, negotiation, problem-solving, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Professional registration or certifications such as PE, PMP, CCM, DBIA, LEED, AACE, or similar are preferred but not required. Travel may be required to various offices, client locations, vendor facilities, or project sites. Physical Requirements Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Ability to stand for extended periods of time. Ability to walk the property and laydown yards. Ability to carry up to 50 pounds. Job Summary:
The Project Manager is responsible for overseeing the completion of projects, ensuring they comply with all safety and legal requirements, and are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. This role involves selecting and tracking equipment and employees needed for the project, monitoring progress, and mitigating risks. The Project Manager works closely with operations and engineering teams to ensure projects are executed correctly and prepares comprehensive reports.
Supervisory Responsibilities:

Supervisory responsibilities over Field Service Technicians with limited authority.

Duties/Responsibilities:
Project Oversight

Oversee the completion of projects, ensuring they run smoothly and comply with safety and legal requirements.
Gain a thorough understanding of the project to monitor budget, progress, and deliverables.

Resource Management

Select and track the type of equipment needed on the project.
Select and track the employees needed on the project and monitor their conduct.

Risk Management

Establish risk factors and develop mitigation strategies.
Eliminate any identified risk factors to ensure project success.

Communication and Collaboration

Communicate effectively with customers, operations, and project teams.
Work closely with operations to ensure the project is performed correctly.
Prepare and deliver comprehensive reports in a timely manner.

Additional responsibilities and tasks as required to support the organization's goals and adapt to evolving business needs.
Attributes/Abilities:

Must have a satisfactory background/MVR check.
Must pass a pre-employment, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, and/or random drug test.
Must work at assigned project sites at least 50% of the time.
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies with proficiency in project management software
Excellent organization, time management, and problem-solving skills.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strategic thinking with the ability to align projects with broader organizational goals.
Adaptable and able to manage shifting priorities in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Experience and Education:

Associate’s degree, trade or technical school certificate/diploma, or Bachelor’s degree preferred.
Any project management certificate preferred.
1-3 years of relevant project management experience

Physical Requirements:

Ability and willingness to work after hours, as needed.
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
Must wear appropriate and mandated PPE including arc-flash suit, safety glasses, hard hat, respirator, hearing protection, steel-toed boots, etc.
Ability to walk, stand, climb, pull, push, sit, and work in a cramped or confined space.
Potential low exposure to various conditions, including dirt, heat, fumes, smoke, water, noise, vibration, grease, oil, and dust.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.ELECTRICAL ENGINEER, POWER SYSTEMS
As a member of the construction projects team, you will work with engineers across multiple disciplines in the design, procurement, and build of infrastructure at our College Station facility. This is a hands-on role responsible for the planning and execution of new facility construction and renovation projects with emphasis on power systems. You will work with construction project managers, facility engineers, designers, vendors, and internal partners/customers to support these goals. You will have the opportunity to drive positive change and own projects from start to finish with the goal of making the SpaceX campus a world-class facility. This position is based in College Station, TX.
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Collaborate and grow with a multi-disciplinary infrastructure project team by performing power-specific engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities for a variety of critical and fast-paced company projects
Develop and issue drawings, design documentation, and reports for manufacturing, industrial, and commercial type projects
Write, negotiate, and manage construction contracts with subcontractors across multiple disciplines through contract close-out
Coordinate with electrical utility provider for design/engineering to ensure reliable power service to critical site infrastructure
Interact with engineers, contractors, fabricators, and project stakeholders

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or electrical engineering technology
3+ years of professional experience with the design and/or build of commercial or industrial power systems

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

5+ years of years of professional experience in a similar role with electrical and power distribution systems (<600Vac)
Professional Engineering (PE) license
Working knowledge of delta/wye transformers, switchgear, motor control centers, building lighting, building construction specifications, and facility grounding
Experience with critical power infrastructure including UPS systems, backup generators, and automatic transfer switches
Experience creating and implementing process/design solutions with minimal impact on business operations
AutoCAD/Revit – beginner to intermediate skill level
Familiarity with the National Electric Code, National Fire Protection Association, and International Building Code
Ability to read and understand power and control schematics and technical equipment operation and maintenance (O&M) manuals
Experience with variable frequency drives (VFDs), industrial pumps, MODBUS communication, medium-voltage distribution and control panel design and production
Ability to quickly assess an issue and assist technicians with troubleshooting and repair
Working knowledge of power coordination and arc flash

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Physical ability to perform hands-on work in various environments, including heat, cold, rain, and tight quarters
Ability to work onsite at our College Station, TX facility (Remote work not considered)
Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed
Ability to travel as needed
Valid driver's license
Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.MECHANICAL ENGINEER
As a member of the construction projects team, you will work with engineers across multiple disciplines in the design, procurement, and build of infrastructure at our College Station facility. This is a hands-on role responsible for the planning and execution of new facility construction and renovation projects with emphasis on mechanical, piping, HVAC, and utility systems. You will work with construction project managers, facility engineers, designers, vendors, and internal partners/customers to support these goals. You will have the opportunity to drive positive change and own projects from start to finish with the goal of making the SpaceX campus a world-class facility. This position is based in College Station, TX.
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead a project team of engineers, consultants, and contractors throughout the engineering, procurement, and construction process
Manage the design, development, and issuance of drawings, documentation, and reports for large commercial or industrial-type facility and infrastructure projects
Write, negotiate, and manage construction contracts with subcontractors across multiple disciplines from conceptual design through closeout and activation
Lead and/or contribute to the design of HVAC systems for various facilities including office, warehouse, and industrial spaces
Use fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, and heat transfer knowledge as required to design tubing and piping systems
Prepare plans, details, specifications, and commercial bid documents for plumbing, heating, ventilating, air conditioning, and general piping systems
Conduct research that tests and analyzes the feasibility, design, operation, and performance of equipment, components, and systems
Recommend designs/modifications to eliminate machine or system malfunctions
Estimate costs and submit bids for engineering and construction projects, and prepare contract documents
Resolve design and construction conflicts in the field in real time with multiple parties
Review and evaluate the work of consultants, contractors, and other external parties
Responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing various construction projects simultaneously
Accountable for accurate budgeting and cost forecasting
Oversee project schedule accuracy and milestone reporting to engineers, contractors, fabricators, and project stakeholders
Coordinate and schedule work with internal SpaceX teams and external general/sub-contractors

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or other engineering discipline
2+ years of professional experience with the design and build of large commercial or industrial-type projects
Experience with mechanical/process piping/HVAC system design and/or project execution

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

5+ years of construction experience with working knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing
Direct field experience with day-to-day management on a construction site
Experience in conceptual design and budgeting
Experience in contract management for large capital projects
Experience in managing the engineering, procurement, and construction process for heavy industrial-type projects
Experience with ASME B31.3 and B31.9 fluid systems
Experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously
Experience creating and implementing process/design solutions with minimal impact to business operations
Able to quickly assess an issue and assist technicians with troubleshooting and repair
Ability to work in a high-concentration, high-stress environment under possible extended work hours and tight deadlines
Acute attention to detail and ability to see interactions with other systems to avoid problems
Familiarity with National Electrical Code, ASHRAE, National Fire Protection Association, American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), and International Building Code
Competency with CAD programs (AutoCAD, Revit, Siemens NX, BIM/Navisworks or similar)

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Physical ability to perform hands-on work in various environments, including heat, cold, rain, and tight quarters
Ability to work onsite at our College Station, TX facility (Remote work not considered)
Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed
Ability to travel as needed
Valid driver's license
Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted
ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Electrical General Foreman
description: Take your next step with Saulsbury Industries! Electrical General Foreman Location: Abernathy Type: Full Time General Information/Job Summary The General Foreman coordinates and directs the activities of multiple Foremen on a project or may coordinate and direct the activities of craft personnel directly. Responsible for ensuring construction and maintenance tasks are completed in a timely, safe, and cost-efficient manner. Works under the direction of a Job Site Superintendent or directly under the direction of a Project Manager. The General Foreman typically works under direction of the Superintendent, but may serve as the lead representative for the company at a construction site, directing and coordinating the activities of the various trade groups such as Carpenters, Equipment Operators, Pipefitters, Welders, Electricians, Instrument Craftsmen, etc. When in this capacity, the General Foreman’s role is like that of the Superintendent, providing overall management oversight for all phases of the construction project, including coordinating workers, material, and equipment and ensuring that specifications are being followed. Responsibilities include making sure that the work progresses according to schedule, that material and equipment are delivered to the site on time, and that the activities of the various workers do not interfere with one another. Confers with supervisory and engineering personnel, inspectors, and suppliers of tools and materials to resolve construction problems and to improve construction methods. Inspects work in progress to ensure that work conforms to specifications and that construction schedules are adhered to. Prepares, or receives from subordinates, reports on progress, materials and equipment used and costs and adjusts work schedules as indicated by reports. Responsibilities/Competencies Must have a broad working knowledge of their assigned craft (carpentry, pipefitting, equipment operation/rigging, instrument/electrical, welding), having the same basic aptitude and interests as those working in the craft they supervise. Must demonstrate an above average knowledge of all facets of their trade and have extensive personal experience performing in the trade. Must possess knowledge of safety procedures and have good interpersonal and communication skills. Responsible for promoting safety awareness and for enforcing safety policies. May at times require overall accountability of Job Site Safety. Develops effective work plans, giving assignments/instructions to foreman and/or work crews and supervises their work activity. Must possess ability to motivate subordinates under their supervision to complete their assigned tasks safely, skillfully, and efficiently, and within the project schedule. Must be able to read and visualize objects from blueprints and have an eye for precise detail. Communicate with Superintendent/Project Manager to keep them informed on progress of work assignments and/or any new problems. Must be able to deal effectively with employees and various levels of customer representatives to resolve scheduling problems, determine work priorities, and assess the relative magnitude of project requirements as they impact project scheduling. Estimates labor, materials, and equipment needed to complete work assignments. Inspects and tests or supervises inspection/testing of completed work assignments of crew, checking for compliance with project drawings, specifications, and quality control procedures. May at times require overall responsibility for quality control/quality assurance. Prepares daily progress reports and maintains records and files. Maintains inventory of material associated with assigned work. Recommends promotion/demotion of subordinates and identifies training needs. Has the authority to discipline, including termination when warranted. Discipline and terminations are discussed with Management prior to acting. Requires working in operating facilities and observing and abiding by additional safety policies and procedures. Other duties as assigned Requirements Four years of experience in work involving a variety of installations of conduit, cable tray, electrical buildings with gear 120-25kv, and cable pulls/terminations for instrumentation, 600 volt to 25kv. Must also be able to report progress that the foreman/leadman have reported for the day and plan the next weeks required materials needed for the work. Must also be able to coordinate with other crafts on simop activities. Three years minimum of experience as an Industrial Electrical Foreman with one year expertise as a General Foreman.
